purpose: Frozen diagnostic candidate rule for the four new CHI:49 motorway holdout tiles; not an accepted Chicago physical-block method.
road_mask: Cook ROW ROWTYPE in {1,4,5} union Cook Road Edge TYPE=1
alley_opening: subtract a 1 m buffer of Cook Road Edge TYPE=5 from the road mask
candidate: closed tile-contained land component with area >= 1000 m2
motorway_source: local Overture transportation-segment 2026-08-19 class=motorway including link subclass
warning: This threshold was chosen from the preceding development tiles; holdout assessment must count false removals and remaining nonblocks.
